'''Jak Masond''' is a commander in the [[Legion of the Dragon]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Jak Masond}}

==Appearance==
He is short and stocky.

==Activities==
He leads the Legion of the Dragon with [[Rand al'Thor]]'s forces to attack the invading [[Seanchan]] just outside [[Illian]].
